claude_only.name: Which identified entity, at which identifier authority, is this provenance record about?
By what mechanism does a verifier confirm that an artifact in hand is the anchored subject?
Does this record anchor more than one subject, and are the statements distributive or joint over them?
What happens to the anchor when the subject is re-encoded, re-serialised or migrated to another format?
At which granularity level is this provenance asserted, and is the same statement inherited by finer levels?
Which aspects of the entity does the statement treat as fixed, such that changing them yields a different entity?
If provenance covers only part of the subject, which part is covered and what is explicitly not covered?
Which provenance elements become mandatory for every instance of the host entity once the mix-in is applied?
Where does provenance attach — on the host entity, on each of its versions, or on a separate assertion object?
What must the host model guarantee about its own identifiers and version boundaries for provenance to remain verifiable?
What identifier does this provenance assertion carry, and who minted it?
Is the assertion immutable once issued, and how is a correction expressed?
How are successive assertions about the same subject ordered and reconciled into a current view?
Which agent issued the assertion, as distinct from the agents named inside it?
Is this provenance bundle itself described as an entity with its own generation activity and responsible agent?
How many levels of provenance-about-provenance are retained, and where does the chain terminate?
When provenance from several sources is merged, what records which statement came from which source bundle?
Which activity generated the subject, and what type of origination was it (capture, authoring, synthesis, derivation, accession)?
What instrument, device or software produced the subject, and at what version?
Was the origination observed and recorded at the time, or reconstructed after the fact?
If origination is unknown, is that recorded explicitly rather than left absent?
Which prior entities were used as sources or ingredients, and in what role did each contribute?
Which source, if any, is the primary source — the originating rather than intermediate account?
For each source, is its own provenance known, absent, or explicitly unknown?
Which dependencies were resolved at the time of production, and were they pinned by digest?
Which typed relation holds between the subject and each related entity, and is a weaker generic influence relation being used because the specific type is unknown?
Through which activity, role and time did the relation come about?
For transformations that consume inputs and produce new outputs, is the input-to-output correspondence one-to-one, many-to-one or unresolvable?
Is the relation asserted forwards from the subject, backwards from a descendant, or both, and which direction is authoritative?
Over what span is the lineage claimed complete, and is completeness asserted or merely not contradicted?
At which nodes does the recorded lineage stop, and why — unknown provenance, redaction, out-of-scope, or an external boundary?
What depth, breadth and cost limits apply when an agent traverses the graph, and what is returned when a limit is hit?
How are cycles or self-referential derivations detected and reported?
What identifies this activity and what type of act was it?
Which parameters were externally supplied and which were internal to the executing platform?
Is the activity claimed to be reproducible, and what would be needed to repeat it?
Which plan, protocol, workflow or algorithm was the activity intended to follow?
Under which mandate, policy or legal basis was the activity authorised?
Did execution deviate from the plan, and is the deviation recorded?
Which identifier and authority identify each responsible agent?
What kind of agent is it — person, group, organisation, position, software agent or device?
In what role did the agent participate in the activity or in relation to the entity?
Where a natural person is named, is a position or organisational role recorded as well so that the record survives staff change?
On whose behalf did each acting agent operate, and how far up does the chain go?
Which component generated the provenance claim, and which party signed it — are they the same?
Which named party accepts responsibility for the accuracy of the assertion?
Which parties have held or controlled the subject, in what order, and over which intervals?
What transfer, accession or acquisition event moved custody, and under what instrument?
Did legal ownership change at the same time as physical or logical custody?
What evidence supports each custody claim, and does any interval rest on inference alone?
Which time axes are recorded for this fact — occurrence, observation, ingestion, publication, validity — and which are mandatory?
Is each timestamp expressed with an explicit UTC offset or Z, and is the local zone offset at the place of the event preserved separately?
What is the permitted gap between occurrence and recording, and how is a backdated or late record flagged?
What precision is claimed for each timestamp, and is a coarse value being stored in a fine-grained field?
Which ordering constraints are enforced, and which are merely reported as warnings?
Has the entity been invalidated, destroyed or expired, and at what time?
When two statements share an identifier, are they merged, and what happens if their attributes conflict?
Is the provenance instance normalised and declared valid, and against which constraint set?
Is a trusted time-stamp token present, and which time authority issued it?
For timestamps without an external token, what clock produced them and what is its known accuracy?
How is the assertion evaluated after the signing credential expires, and does the time-stamp preserve its evidential value?
At what place did the activity occur or the observation take place?
Where a physical place is meaningless, what logical location applies — system, region, tenancy or endpoint?
Which jurisdiction governs the activity and the resulting provenance record, and does it differ from where the record is stored?
Which digest values over which algorithms are recorded for the subject, and over exactly what byte extent?
Who or what computed each digest, and is it independently reproducible?
When was fixity last verified, with what outcome, and on what schedule is it re-checked?
What happens when a digest algorithm is deprecated — are historic digests retained alongside new ones?
Which binding methods are in force, and does the record rely on a hard binding, a soft binding, or both?
What does each binding actually prove — byte integrity, perceptual identity, or mere association?
Is the provenance carried inside the subject, alongside it, or only in an external store, and what happens if it is stripped?
Is the binding machine-readable and detectable by a third party without prior arrangement?
What is the envelope structure — payload, payload type, signature — and which parts are covered by the signature?
Which identity signed the assertion, evidenced by which credential?
Which statements does the signer originate and take responsibility for, and which were merely gathered from other components?
Can the signature be verified without the original transport, and what canonical form must be reconstructed?
Against which trust anchors or trust lists is the signer evaluated, and who curates that list?
What was the credential status at signing time and at verification time — valid, expired, revoked or unknown?
Can a previously trusted assertion become untrusted, and is the earlier verdict retained rather than overwritten?
How is an assertion from an unrecognised but cryptographically sound signer treated?
What grade did verification reach, and which specific checks passed, failed or were skipped?
When some checks fail, is the remaining provenance still usable and under what caveat?
How does a producer retract or correct a previously published provenance statement it now knows to be wrong?
How often is verification repeated, and what triggers an out-of-cycle re-verification?
Is each statement directly recorded, inferred from other statements, or asserted without supporting evidence?
How is confidence expressed, and is the scale defined well enough to be compared across producers?
When two producers assert incompatible provenance for the same subject, are both retained and how is precedence decided?
Does absence of a provenance statement mean the fact is unknown, not applicable, or withheld?
Was the subject wholly or partly generated or manipulated by an AI system, and which parts?
By what mechanism is the AI-generated status marked so that it is machine-readable and detectable downstream?
What summary of training content is available for the generating model, and at what level of detail?
Where a person must be told that content is artificially generated or manipulated, when and how is that disclosure made?
From which source did the personal data originate, and can that be stated to the data subject on request?
To which recipients has the data been disclosed, so that rectification or erasure can be communicated to each?
Which record of processing activities does this provenance feed, and which controller or processor maintains it?
Does the provenance record itself contain personal data about contributing agents, and is that necessary and minimised?
Given only the subject, by what mechanism does a consumer locate provenance about it?
What query surface is offered — record retrieval, ancestor traversal, descendant traversal — and with what parameters?
Is there a channel by which downstream users notify the producer of derived works, and is that channel trusted?
What availability and durability are guaranteed for provenance retrieval, and what does a consumer do when the record is unreachable?
Which provenance elements have been redacted, and is the fact of redaction recorded even when the content is gone?
Does the record still verify after redaction, and which checks necessarily fail?
Who is authorised to redact, and can a downstream party redact statements made by an upstream producer?
Are different views of the provenance released to different audiences, and how are those views kept consistent?
For how long must this provenance record be retained, under which authority, and does that differ from the subject's own retention?
Does provenance survive deletion of the subject, and in what reduced form?
When provenance is destroyed, what evidence of the destruction is itself retained?
How does a legal hold or investigation suspend disposition, and who may lift it?
To which external vocabularies is a mapping maintained, at which versions?
For each mapped element, is the mapping exact, broader, narrower or approximate, and what is lost on round trip?
Is conformance to any external standard claimed, and what evidence supports the claim?
How is drift handled when a mapped external vocabulary publishes a new version?

grok_only.name: What is the authoritative master-system identifier of this provenance record, and which system assigned it?
What kind of provenance record is this (bundle, manifest, attestation statement, preservation event set, traceability event)?
When was this record generated, by which generator, and at what observation or ingestion time was it received here?
What namespace, IRI or URN scheme governs identifiers inside this record, and is a Dimension UUID or ULID used only as a fallback?
Which subject entity does this record describe, and is that identifier the resource URI, a versioned target-URI, or a digest?
Does the record describe the whole asset, a constrained view, a byte range, a live-video segment, or a collection member?
If several target identifiers are present, which identifiers must a consumer isolate before interpreting assertions?
Is this entity a specialization of a more general resource, and which fixed aspects distinguish it?
Which alternate entities present other aspects of the same thing, such as another format or revision snapshot?
Which attributes are fixed for the lifetime of this entity, and would a change require a new entity identifier?
What identifier and types describe this entity, and is it also typed as an agent, collection, plan or bundle?
When was this entity generated and, if applicable, invalidated, and by which activities?
Is a literal value a direct representation of this entity, and what location if any situates it?
What identifier, type and plan describe this activity?
When did this activity start and end, and which entities started or ended it?
Does this activity align to a PREMIS eventType, C2PA action, EPCIS event type, ISO process step or SLSA buildType?
What identifier and agent type (person, organization, software) identify this responsibility-bearer?
Is the agent's own provenance in scope, and which entity identifier represents the agent as a thing with history?
Does this identifier also denote an activity, and if so does that violate disjointness constraints?
Which activity generated this entity, at what time, and in what role?
Was this activity informed by another activity, implying an unspecified exchanged entity?
Is there at most one generation of this entity in this instance, as required for valid PROV?
Which entity or activity started this activity, and at what time?
Which entity or activity ended this activity, and at what time?
Which activity invalidated this entity, at what time, and is the entity no longer available for use?
From which entity or entities was this entity derived, and what derivation type applies?
Which activity, generation and usage instantiate this derivation when the relation is expanded?
Is a primary source asserted, meaning an agent with direct experience produced the used entity?
Is this a revision of substantial content, a quotation, a format alternate, or only a weaker Dublin Core version or reference relation?
What general explanation of lineage is known when detailed sources or steps are absent?
What process steps were applied, when, by which processors, with what rationale and software or algorithm?
Which source resources were used, with what citations, extents and processed levels?
Which ingredient assets or resolved dependencies were used, and do they carry their own provenance manifests?
What buildType or action sequence produced the output, and which parameters were external versus platform-internal?
Are resolved dependencies complete, best-effort, or known incomplete, and which transitive fetches are missing?
To which agents is this entity attributed, and in which roles such as creator, contributor or publisher?
Which agents were associated with this activity, with what roles and plans?
On whose behalf did this agent act, and for which activity does residual responsibility remain?
Who currently has physical custody or legal responsibility for custody of the subject?
Who currently holds legal title, and is title distinct from custody?
What transfers of custody or title occurred, from whom to whom, when, where, and were they voluntary, unknown-source, loss or theft?
Which custody or ownership changes are significant for authenticity, integrity or interpretation, and which successive custodians altered the resource?
Which hardware or software generated the claim, on which operating system, and against which specification version?
Who is the credential holder that signed the claim, and which certificate, EKU and trust list apply?
What builder.id represents the trusted platform, and which fields were tenant-generated rather than control-plane-generated?
What is the event time of this generation, usage, invalidation, start, end or other provenance event, with seconds and explicit offset or Z?
When was this fact observed or ingested, and is that distinct from the event time?
Do the events in this instance satisfy generation-before-usage, start-before-end and related ordering constraints, or is the instance invalid?
Which clock produced this timestamp, and is cross-system alignment only partial?
Where did this activity or event occur, in what location identifier or description?
At which location is this characterized entity situated during its lifetime?
Is the location only a reference to a Place model, or is an inline label sufficient?
What hash algorithm and hash values bind this record to which byte ranges or boxes of the asset?
Is a fingerprint or watermark present that can recover a detached manifest from a repository?
Has fixity been verified against the recorded hashes, and what is the current integrity state?
Does the claim signature verify, was it made while the credential was valid, and is revocation information current?
Which trust list and TSA trust list were used, and is the signer an accepted pair with the builder or claim generator?
What SLSA Build level is claimed or verified, and does provenance authenticity meet the corresponding bar?
Is the manifest well-formed, valid, trusted, or only partially interpretable due to unknown constructs?
Is this record asserted complete, best-effort, or known incomplete, and which expected fields are absent?
Which assertions were redacted, by whom, and is the redaction declared so that hashes still verify?
Does this instance satisfy uniqueness, typing, impossibility and event-ordering constraints after normalization?
Has any consumer inferred that valid provenance means the content is authentic or good, contrary to C2PA non-goals?
Where can this provenance record be retrieved, and which target-URI does that record use for the subject?
Which query service can return provenance for this target, and what URI template or SPARQL endpoint does it expose?
Is a pingback URI published, and which downstream provenance-URIs have been posted against it?
Do multiple providers offer provenance about the same target, and how should contradictions be handled?
Who may read this provenance record or specific layers, findings or artifacts, and what is the default deny or allow rule?
Did the creator withhold or redact personal or sensitive provenance fields, and under which privacy basis?
How long must this record be retained, when may it be deleted or invalidated, and does archive policy require preserving provenance of deletions?
Would disclosing that a provenance record exists itself leak sensitive information, requiring a non-404 denial?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
